candidates.title: Time To Pet - Pet Care App
candidates.verbatim_top_low: They claim to have updated the app so it wouldn't freeze when you send the report. The problem got worse. I could have my uploads go through and once it gets to finalizing it doesn't go through. I have to close and try again. And that's if I can get through that. It has gotten to the point I have to restart my phone entirely to make a report go through.
candidates.vulnerability_thesis: STRONG cell — 60% recent low on n=15. Pet-care pro CRM with chronic Android stability issues (freeze on report send). Pet sitters/walkers stuck because client base is locked to the platform.
